articles.title: Bitcoin's on a streak it hasn't hit since 2012
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s 10% September gain puts it on track for a rare three-month winning streak last seen in 2012.

articles.title: ESMA to prioritize EU-wide AI and tokenization supervision in 2027
articles.snippet: National regulators will map client-facing uses of the technologies, check a subset of firms and develop common approaches to oversight.

articles.title: Bitcoin Dips, But Its Forks Are Flying Again
articles.snippet: A CME futures listing and a fresh Grayscale ETF filing sent Bitcoin's two biggest forks soaring, even as the flagship coin cooled off its seven-month high.

articles.title: BlackRock: AI Agents Could Drive Crypto's Next Demand Wave
articles.snippet: The world's largest asset manager argues that autonomous AI agents buying data, paying for services, and renting computing power could quietly become one of the biggest forces pushing money into crypto.

articles.title: Bernstein Predicts $10 Trillion Prediction Market by 2035—10X Its Original Forecast
articles.snippet: Bernstein now projects prediction markets will handle $10 trillion a year by 2035, up from its own $1 trillion by 2030 forecast made just five months ago.
